items.title: PBR Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Output Growth and Pricing Scrutiny
items.summary: Petrobras raised its 2026 oil production forecast to 2.7-2.8 million barrels per day from 2.5 million, driven by better reservoir management and operational efficiency. The company also increased capital expenditure guidance to $24-$25.5 billion and operating cash flow outlook to $45-$50 billion, supported by higher oil prices. However, executives faced repeated questions about gasoline pricing consistency and rising leasing costs for drilling rigs and vessels.
